name: In the Eye of the Storm
description: This series reveals recent natural disasters as they happened in real-time through footage captured by eyewitnesses who found themselves in the wrong place at the right time and boldly held up their camera phones to capture the eye of the storm.

videos.title: Shark Storm
videos.overview: In the summer of 2024, dozens of cameras captured a rare outbreak of shark attacks along America's Gulf Coast; told exclusively through first-hand accounts of victims and eyewitnesses, nobody has seen all these perspectives unfold in real time.

videos.title: Monster in Michigan
videos.overview: When a rare EF-3 tornado touches down in northern Michigan, cameras capture the chaos and disbelief.

videos.title: Trapped in a Twister
videos.overview: Hundreds of cameras capture a rare tornado outbreak in 2023 as it struck Rolling Fork, Mississippi and Little Rock, Arkansas; when a twister hits Lewistown, Illinois, a group of tornado spotters find themselves trapped in the eye of the deadly storm.

videos.title: Derecho Superstorm
videos.overview: Hundreds of people in Nebraska and Iowa capture videos of their terrifying escapes as a powerful derecho superstorm tears through the region.

videos.title: Hellfire in Hawaii
videos.overview: Maui faces the worst natural disaster in its history in 2023, as hurricane-force winds fuel wildfires that catch residents off guard. As eyewitnesses attempt to flee the flames, they film their harrowing attempts to escape from the eye of the storm.

videos.title: Half-Country Hurricane
videos.overview: Hundreds of cameras capture Hurricane Ida as the Category 4 storm slams the Louisiana coast in 2021, but when the superstorm shifts to the Northeast, eyewitnesses film harrowing encounters with tornadoes and flooding all the way to New York City.

videos.title: Snowmageddon
videos.overview: Snowmageddon. When a rare multi-day blizzard buries thousands in Buffalo, one woman must brave arctic conditions to save a man freezing to death outside her home.

videos.title: Texas Tornado
videos.overview: When a tornado outbreak strikes Texas and Kansas in 2022, eyewitnesses capture the chaos as twisters wreak havoc on the structures around them.

videos.title: Texas Derecho Disaster
videos.overview: In 2024, as a monster storm system unleashes a record-breaking derecho across Texas, eyewitnesses capture multiple destructive tornadoes on camera; when one twister targets a remote farmhouse, a weather spotter must race to save a young family.

videos.title: Double Hurricane Disaster
videos.overview: In 2024, hundreds of cameras capture back-to-back hurricanes slamming Florida's Gulf Coast. Just as Category 4 Hurricane Helene brings record flooding, residents have no chance to recover before Category 3 Hurricane Milton unleashes over 40 tornadoes.

videos.title: Helene's Appalachian Hellscape
videos.overview: Hurricane Helene barrels north into Appalachia, dumping 30 inches of rain. As hundreds of cameras capture massive flooding and mudslides, one woman gets swept away by the deluge, until a man attending a wedding rehearsal jumps into the water to save her.

videos.title: Nebraska Super Outbreak
videos.overview: In April 2024, dozens of tornadoes ravaged NE's Central Plains; eyewitnesses find themselves in the wrong place at the wrong time as twisters tear through neighborhoods, demolish massive commercial structures, and topple semi-trailers.

videos.title: Nightmare Before Christmas
videos.overview: During Christmas in 2023, severe storms unleashed an unseasonal tornado outbreak across Tennessee. As dozens of eyewitnesses capture the unbelievable, destructive power of nature, a twister strikes an electrical substation, triggering a massive explosion.

videos.title: Terrifying Twin Twisters
videos.overview: In May 2024, dozens of eyewitnesses capture rare twin tornadoes as they carve a parallel path of destruction across Iowa; with winds near 300 mph, the twister sisters topple farms, shred wind turbines and devastate the town of Greenfield.

videos.title: Tornado Torrent 2025
videos.overview: In March 2025, thousands of eyewitnesses capture disaster at their doorsteps as extreme atmospheric volatility unleashes a massive Texas haboob and more than 250 tornadoes across the southern states, devastating towns and homesteads in their path.

videos.title: Category 5: Fight to Survive
videos.overview: After hitting Category 5, Hurricane Ian slams Florida's Gulf Coast with 150 mph winds and a storm surge that sweeps away homes. Cameras capture residents who unwisely stay behind as they combat one of the strongest storms to make landfall in U.S. history.

videos.title: The Mayfield Beast
videos.overview: When a rare winter supercell hits Kentucky, cameras capture the unfolding disaster as a powerful EF-4 tornado devastates Mayfield, leveling the courthouse, police headquarters and jail where officers race to rescue trapped inmates while preventing escape.

videos.title: Escaping the LA Fires
videos.overview: When wind-driven fires explode across Los Angeles in January 2025, cameras capture chaos and heroism as residents attempt to rescue loved ones and flee burning neighborhoods, while the entire city faces one of the most destructive infernos in its history.

videos.title: Nightmare in May
videos.overview: In mid-May 2025, hundreds of eyewitnesses capture the terrifying power of severe weather as supercell thunderstorms unleash dozens of powerful tornadoes, tossing vehicles across motorways and destroying neighbourhoods and workplaces in eleven states.

videos.title: That Car's Flying!
videos.overview: As Hurricane Idalia makes landfall along Florida's Gulf Coast, evacuation holdouts face a 12-foot storm surge and 125 mph winds. The once-in-a-generation storm devastates inland structures and overturns rush-hour traffic 350 miles away in Charleston, SC.

videos.title: Monster in Michigan
videos.overview: When a rare EF-3 tornado touches down in northern Michigan, cameras capture the chaos and disbelief as the twister's 150 mph winds disintegrate shopping centers, toss vehicles and carve a path of utter destruction through a city that never saw it coming.

videos.title: Houston Hurricane Hell
videos.overview: When Hurricane Harvey hit Texas with 130 mph winds and record-breaking rain, cameras captured catastrophic flooding as entire neighborhoods vanished, forcing civilians to risk their own lives to save others in one of the costliest disasters in US history.

videos.title: The Dakota EF5
videos.overview: Eyewitnesses capture severe weather across the Dakotas as tornadoes tear through neighborhoods and farm structures. Near Enderlin, ND, a violent twister with estimated winds exceeding 200 mph becomes the first U.S. tornado rated EF5 in more than 12 years.

videos.title: Flood of the Century
videos.overview: When a freak storm unleashes a tornado and a year's worth of rainfall on the city of Valencia, Spain, stunned eyewitnesses capture catastrophic flooding in the urban center as bridges buckle, cars are swept away, and residents fight for their lives.
